# kumo.productions

## Showreel

Our showreel showcases the signature works of all three kumo™ members, set to an original composition by phritz. We encourage you to take a look.
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8aNl_7fvrrk>

## About

kumo.productions™ is a video production studio based in Tokyo.
Specializing in motion design and CGI, we provide tailored services for every stage of video production, from planning to post-production.

## Introduction

Tomoya Eguchi (Representative of Cumuloworks, Inc.) is pleased to announce that Akito Osawa (SHIGU), a long-time collaborator on various projects, has joined the company as a new executive member.
With this milestone, we have launched kumo.productions™, as a new initiative in video production.
The name 'Cumuloworks' will continue to serve as Eguchi's personal creative identity.

## Services

### Commercials
> Planning and Production of Video Advertisements
From planning and direction to CG production and post-production, kumo™ offers comprehensive services for creating video advertisements. With creative ideas and advanced techniques, we craft videos that effectively convey your brand's message.

### Character Animation
> Video Production Utilizing Character CG
Character CG-based video production is one of kumo™'s specialties. We plan concepts that bring out the charm of characters and provide end-to-end production, including motion capture, animation, and simulation.

### Visual Effects
> VFX Production for Ads and Music Videos
We add CG elements to live-action footage to create impactful visual presentations. At kumo™, our established proprietary workflows and techniques enable us to quickly produce high-quality effects tailored to the needs of advertisements and music videos.

### Motion Graphics
> Impactful Motion Graphics
kumo™ produces motion graphics that effectively convey information and stories. By incorporating 3D elements, we pursue high-quality motion designs that enhance the intent of graphic design.

## Members

### Tomoya Eguchi (Cumuloworks)
Executive Director, Motion Designer, CG Generalist
He began creating motion graphics under the name Cumuloworks during his high school years. After gaining two years of experience at Naname Inc., he officially established Cumuloworks, Inc. in 2020. Within kumo.productions™, he focuses on motion design and CGI, delivering a diverse range of projects including commercials, music videos, and live stage productions. He is also committed to research and development, particularly in creating tools for video production and improving workflows.
[cumulo.works](https://cumulo.works)

### Akito Osawa (SHIGU)
Director, CG Artist
With over two and a half years of experience at a CG studio in Tokyo, now working as a 3D artist at kumo.productions™. Specializing in Previz and LookDev, while also managing a broad range of workflows across CG production. Projects include commercials, music videos, and more, with a focus on creating groundbreaking visuals and exploring new forms of expression.
[shigu.works](https://shigu.works)

### Takami Yuki (Reflex)
CG Artist
After working as a CG designer at a VTuber company in Tokyo, now works as a freelance CG artist. Mainly produces VR content and music videos, often using Unity for production.
[reflexatelier.com](https://reflexatelier.com)

### Minami Fuji (Asteroid)
Art Director, Graphic Designer, Illustrator
He works across a wide range of fields, from print and on-screen graphic design to three-dimensional works and installations, as well as visual direction for commercials, music videos, and online content. His practice also extends to spatial design for stores and exhibitions, and even shaping the overall direction of brands.
[astero.work](https://astero.work/)

## Projects

### Voices of Galaxy: Kazlaser Edition (June 15, 2026)

kumo™ was in charge of video production, system development, and playout support for the LED background visuals in the "Voices of Galaxy: Kazlaser Edition" video.

### Pigg U Release Movie (April 28, 2026)

kumo.productions™ was in charge of the CG production for the release movie of "Pigg U," the first 3D avatar community app in the Pigg series.

We at kumo™ produced the promotional video for Raidori, a streamer fan club service.
